title: The Army Knew Much Earlier of the Explosive Risk in Iowa, Evidence Suggests
summary: Efforts to get rid of unstable explosives at an Iowa plant began more than a year ago but weren’t completed at that time, setting the stage for Wednesday’s controversial blast.
